aspects.name: Territory and minimum purchases
justifications: Defines the Territory as France (mainland and Corsica, excluding overseas departments) and Monaco, the area of the exclusive distribution.
Grants the Distributor exclusivity in the Territory, with the Manufacturer barred from appointing other dealers or supplying customers there directly.
Limits the Distributor's sales outside the Territory: no active marketing, branches or warehouses, though unsolicited orders may be fulfilled.
Sets the minimum purchase quantity of 120 pumps per calendar year, excluding spare parts.
Credits the initial stocking order towards the minimum purchase quantity for 2027.
Sets the consequence of a shortfall: the Manufacturer may revoke exclusivity on three months' notice, with no further claims.
Amendment extends the Territory to Belgium with exclusivity from 1 January 2028 and permits non-exclusive active sales in Luxembourg, which is outside the Territory.
Amendment reduces the 2028 minimum purchase quantity by 25%, counts Belgian and Luxembourg products toward it, and leaves later years unchanged.

aspects.name: Delivery and transport risk
justifications: Specifies the delivery term as FCA Werk Lindenfurt (Incoterms 2020), with the Distributor bearing transport costs from the works.
Transfers the risk of loss or deterioration to the Distributor upon handover to its carrier at the Lindenfurt works.
Sets delivery periods starting from order confirmation and governs partial deliveries and withdrawal for delay.
Annex 1 specifies FCA Lindenfurt delivery and lead times of 6 weeks for HP-200 and HP-350 and 10 weeks for HP-500.
Amendment replaces the delivery term with DAP the Distributor's warehouse in Bellerive-sur-Erdre from 1 March 2028, with transport costs borne by the Manufacturer.
Amendment shifts risk transfer to the moment goods are made available at the Distributor's warehouse, ready for unloading, with unloading at the Distributor's cost and risk.

aspects.name: Prices and payment
justifications: Sets the list prices as net of VAT, including standard packaging, with delivery under Section 5.1.
States the list price of an HP-350 pump as EUR 7,150 net per unit under the price list at contract signing.
Grants an 8% introductory discount on list prices for the initial stocking order and excludes other discounts.
Permits list price adjustments from 1 January 2028, at most once a year, capped at 4% with three months' written notice.
Provides that each delivery is invoiced on the date risk passes, electronically to the Distributor's invoicing address.
Sets payment within 30 days of the invoice date and a 2% early-payment discount for payment within 10 days.
Provides that the German text prevails over Annex 1 in conflicts, except that Annex 1 governs technical data and list prices, even where Annex 1 states otherwise.
Annex 1 sets the initial stocking order of 10 HP-200, 6 HP-350 and 2 HP-500 units, invoiced on 15 March 2027.
Annex 1 sets payment at 45 days net from invoice date with a 2% early-payment discount within 10 days, which differs from the Agreement's 30-day term.

aspects.name: Warranty and product performance
justifications: Requires inspection of goods on receipt and written notice of obvious defects within eight working days, and hidden defects within eight working days of discovery, failing which goods are deemed approved.
Sets the warranty period for the Contract Products at 24 months from passing of risk.
Sets a 12-month warranty period for Wear Parts, which Annex 1 defines.
Guarantees the pumps meet the technical data in Annex 1 at risk transfer, and a minimum 78% efficiency for HP-500 at best efficiency point.
Provides remedies for defects: Manufacturer's choice of repair or replacement, with rescission or price reduction after two failed attempts, and the Manufacturer bearing costs.
Obliges the Manufacturer to keep spare parts available in the scope and duration set by Annex 1.
Provides that the German text prevails over Annex 1 in conflicts, except that Annex 1 governs technical data and list prices, even where Annex 1 states otherwise.
Annex 1 states guaranteed minimum efficiency values at best efficiency point, verified per pump by factory acceptance test to ISO 9906.
Annex 1 defines Wear Parts as mechanical seals, O-rings, wear rings and bearing bushes, excluding impellers, shafts and casings.
Annex 1 commits the Manufacturer to supply spare parts for 10 years after series production ends, with stock parts dispatched within 5 working days.

concepts.name: Amendment No. 1 effective date
justifications: Amendment No. 1 enters into force on the date of signature by the last party, which is the Manufacturer's signature dated 19 November 2027 after the Distributor signed on 12 November 2027.

concepts.name: Changes made by Amendment No. 1
predicted: from 1 january 2028 the territory is extended to belgium with exclusivity, luxembourg is opened to non-exclusive active sales without being part of the territory, the 2028 minimum purchase is reduced by 25%, and from 1 march 2028 deliveries are dap to the distributor's bellerive-sur-erdre warehouse with risk transferring on arrival.
gold: from 1 january 2028 it adds belgium to the exclusive territory and allows non-exclusive sales in luxembourg, it reduces the 2028 minimum purchase quantity by 25 %, and for deliveries from 1 march 2028 it replaces fca lindenfurt with dap delivery to the distributor's bellerive-sur-erdre warehouse, where the risk then passes.
values: From 1 January 2028 the territory is extended to Belgium with exclusivity, Luxembourg is opened to non-exclusive active sales without being part of the territory, the 2028 minimum purchase is reduced by 25%, and from 1 March 2028 deliveries are DAP to the Distributor's Bellerive-sur-Erdre warehouse with risk transferring on arrival.
justifications: The amendment's articles extend the territory, permit non-exclusive sales in Luxembourg, reduce the 2028 minimum purchase, and change the delivery and risk terms.

concepts.name: Governing law and jurisdiction
predicted: german law (excluding the cisg) governs the agreement, and the courts of lindenfurt have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes.
gold: german law, excluding the cisg; the courts of lindenfurt have exclusive jurisdiction.
values: German law (excluding the CISG) governs the agreement, and the courts of Lindenfurt have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes.
justifications: Section 8 of the agreement selects German law excluding the CISG and makes Lindenfurt the exclusive place of jurisdiction.

concepts.name: Prevailing text between the agreement and Annex 1
predicted: the german agreement text prevails over annex 1 for conflicts, except for technical data and list prices, for which annex 1 prevails, even where annex 1 provides otherwise.
gold: the german agreement prevails, except for technical data and list prices, for which annex 1 prevails.
values: The German agreement text prevails over Annex 1 for conflicts, except for technical data and list prices, for which Annex 1 prevails, even where Annex 1 provides otherwise.
justifications: Section 9.3 gives the German text precedence in conflicts but makes Annex 1 controlling for technical data and list prices regardless of contrary Annex wording.

concepts.name: HP-700 is a Contract Product
justifications: The HP-700 series is listed only for information and is not a Contract Product unless added by a written amendment, which has not been made; the amendment only agrees to examine adding it later.

justifications: Table 1.1 of Annex 1 lists this Contract Product with a list price of EUR 4,850 net per unit, and the amendment leaves Annex 1 prices unchanged.
Table 1.1 of Annex 1 gives a list price of EUR 7,250 net per unit, which prevails over the EUR 7,150 figure in the agreement body for list prices.
Table 1.1 of Annex 1 lists this Contract Product with a list price of EUR 11,400 net per unit, and the amendment leaves Annex 1 prices unchanged.

concepts.name: Countries of the exclusive territory in 2028
justifications: The original territory covers France and Monaco, and the amendment extends the Distributor's same exclusivity to Belgium from 2028. Luxembourg is excluded because the Distributor may sell there only non-exclusively.

concepts.name: Minimum purchase quantity for 2028 in pumps
justifications: The original minimum of 120 pumps per calendar year is reduced by 25% for 2028 under the amendment, giving 90 pumps.

concepts.name: Consequence of a minimum purchase shortfall
predicted: the manufacturer may revoke the distributor's exclusivity by written notice with a three-month period, after which the contract continues as a non-exclusive distribution agreement; it may not claim damages or terminate the contract for the shortfall.
gold: the manufacturer may revoke the distributor's exclusivity by written notice with three months' notice, the agreement continuing as a non-exclusive one; it has no other rights or claims for the shortfall, such as damages or termination.
values: The Manufacturer may revoke the Distributor's exclusivity by written notice with a three-month period, after which the contract continues as a non-exclusive distribution agreement; it may not claim damages or terminate the contract for the shortfall.
justifications: The clause allows exclusivity revocation with three months' notice and expressly excludes other rights such as damages or termination. The amendment does not alter this consequence.

concepts.name: Incoterm of a delivery on 12 April 2028
justifications: The change to delivery terms applies to deliveries made from 1 March 2028, so a delivery on 12 April 2028 falls under DAP (Incoterms 2020) delivery to the Distributor's warehouse in Bellerive-sur-Erdre.

concepts.name: Passing of the transport risk
predicted: before the change (fca lindenfurt), the risk passes to the distributor when the goods are handed over to the carrier it nominates at the lindenfurt plant; from the change onward (dap), the risk passes when the goods are made available on the arriving transport vehicle at the distributor's bellerive-sur-erdre warehouse, ready for unloading, with unloading at the distributor's cost and risk.
gold: for deliveries before 1 march 2028 the risk passes to the distributor when the goods are handed to its carrier at the lindenfurt plant (fca); for deliveries from 1 march 2028 the manufacturer bears it until the goods are made available, ready for unloading, at the distributor's warehouse in bellerive-sur-erdre (dap).
values: Before the change (FCA Lindenfurt), the risk passes to the Distributor when the goods are handed over to the carrier it nominates at the Lindenfurt plant; from the change onward (DAP), the risk passes when the goods are made available on the arriving transport vehicle at the Distributor's Bellerive-sur-Erdre warehouse, ready for unloading, with unloading at the Distributor's cost and risk.
justifications: The FCA clause transfers risk at handover to the Distributor's nominated carrier, while the amended DAP clause transfers risk on arrival at the Distributor's warehouse, ready for unloading.

concepts.name: Net value of the initial stocking order in EUR
Payment due date of the initial stocking order invoice
justifications: The initial stocking order is invoiced on 15 March 2027. The contract's 30-day payment term, which prevails over Annex 1's 45-day term for payment terms under the conflict rule, runs from the invoice date without counting that day, ending on 14 April 2027.

concepts.name: Guaranteed minimum efficiency of HP-500 at BEP in %
justifications: The manufacturer guarantees a minimum efficiency of at least 78% at the best efficiency point for the HP-500 series.

concepts.name: Warranty period of a mechanical seal in months
justifications: Mechanical seals are classified as Wear Parts, and the warranty period for Wear Parts is twelve months from the passing of risk, which overrides the general 24-month period.

concepts.name: Spare parts supply period
predicted: the manufacturer must supply spare parts for each contract product series for 10 years after the end of its series production.
gold: for 10 years after the end of the series production of each contract product series.
values: The Manufacturer must supply spare parts for each Contract Product series for 10 years after the end of its series production.
justifications: The spare parts supply obligation runs for 10 years after the end of each product series' production, and the scope is set by the appendix.
